headlines.title: Why Should General Motors Stock Holders Watch This Number?
headlines.summary: General Motors (GM) posted a 5.5% decline in U.S. new vehicle sales for the third quarter of 2026. This metric matters to investors because North America generated $3.4 billion of the automaker's $3.9 billion adjusted operating profit in the second quarter. The company had also raised its 2026 profit forecast in July, before this latest sales figure was released. But why did GM's U.S. sales fall.

headlines.title: Why General Motors is dropping Blue Cross for salaried workers
headlines.summary: The automaker will be switching the administrator for its self-insured health coverage starting Jan. 1.

headlines.title: GM stock will see major benefit from latest redesign, analyst says
headlines.summary: It’s been seven years since GM redesigned these popular pickup trucks, but analysts believe shares could see a bump from the new look.

headlines.title: General Motors vs. Tesla: What Revenue Growth Trends Tell Investors About These Automotive Giants
headlines.summary: GM's revenue lead persists across all eight quarters, yet Tesla's growth volatility and recent acceleration raise questions about the widening gap's durability.

headlines.title: Why Bank of America is bullish on GM's truck overhaul
headlines.summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi takes a look at General Motors (GM) overhaul of its workhorse trucks and breaks down a bullish note from Bank of America (BAC), which suggests the redesigns could help the automaker protect its market share and strengthen its competitive position.

description: General Motors Company designs, builds, and sells trucks, crossovers, cars, and automobile parts worldwide. It operates through GM North America, GM International, and GM Financial segments. The company markets its vehicles primarily under the Buick, Cadillac, Chevrolet, GMC, Baojun, and Wuling brand names. In addition, it sells trucks, crossovers, cars, and automobile parts through retail dealers, distributors and dealers, as well as to fleet customers, including daily rental car companies, commercial fleet customers, leasing companies, and governments. Further, the company offers various range of after-sale services through dealer network, such as maintenance, light repairs, collision repairs, vehicle accessories, and extended service warranties. Additionally, it provides automotive financing; and software-enabled services and subscriptions. General Motors Company was founded in 1908 and is based in Detroit, Michigan.
